en.name: Greater Tech Challenge 2025
en.description: The flagship innovation competition bridging Latin America and China for founders building in AI, cleantech, biotech, and advanced infrastructure.
en.detailSubtitle: A cross-border startup competition designed to surface export-ready ventures that can scale between Latin America and China with investor, corporate, and ecosystem support.
en.metaTitle: Greater Tech Challenge 2025 | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Explore the Greater Tech Challenge 2025, a flagship LATAM-China startup competition for deep-tech founders.
en.overviewHtml:
Greater Tech Challenge 2025 is built for ambitious founders solving industrial, climate, and infrastructure problems that matter on both sides of the LATAM-China corridor.

The program combines visibility, prize funding, and curated introductions so selected teams can move from exposure to real commercial follow-through.
en.eligibilityHtml:
• Startups with a working product, pilot, or strong technical prototype.
  • Teams able to articulate why China-LATAM collaboration creates leverage for growth.
  • Founders in AI, cleantech, biotech, advanced manufacturing, logistics, or adjacent deep-tech sectors.
en.supportHtml:
• Access to the full prize pool and finalist visibility.
  • Cross-border investor and corporate introductions through LATAM China Tech.
  • Application support, positioning feedback, and narrative refinement before final submission.
en.processHtml:
Use this section to shape the pitch narrative, sector proof points, partner fit, and cross-border growth story that the judging team should understand first.

The LATAM China Tech team can keep this area updated with program photos, finalist guidance, and competition-specific notes as the opportunity evolves.
en.featureImageAlt: Founders preparing a cross-border competition pitch.

br.name: Greater Tech Challenge 2025
br.description: A competição principal que conecta América Latina e China para founders em AI, cleantech, biotech e infraestrutura avançada.
br.detailSubtitle: Uma competição cross-border desenhada para destacar startups prontas para escalar entre América Latina e China com apoio de investidores, corporates e parceiros de ecossistema.
br.metaTitle: Greater Tech Challenge 2025 | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Conheça o Greater Tech Challenge 2025, a principal competição LATAM-China para startups de deep tech.
br.overviewHtml:
O Greater Tech Challenge 2025 foi criado para founders que estão resolvendo problemas industriais, climáticos e de infraestrutura relevantes dos dois lados do corredor LATAM-China.

O programa combina visibilidade, prêmios e introduções curadas para transformar exposição em avanços comerciais reais.
br.eligibilityHtml:
• Startups com produto funcional, piloto ou protótipo técnico forte.
  • Times capazes de explicar por que a colaboração China-LATAM acelera o crescimento.
  • Founders em AI, cleantech, biotech, manufatura avançada, logística ou setores adjacentes.
br.supportHtml:
• Acesso ao prize pool e visibilidade como finalista.
  • Introduções a investidores e corporates via LATAM China Tech.
  • Apoio na candidatura, posicionamento e refinamento da narrativa antes da submissão final.
br.processHtml:
Use esta seção para estruturar a narrativa de pitch, provas do setor, fit com parceiros e historia de crescimento cross-border que os avaliadores devem entender primeiro.

A equipe LATAM China Tech pode manter esta area atualizada com fotos do programa, orientacoes para finalistas e notas especificas da competicao.
br.featureImageAlt: Founders preparando um pitch de competicao cross-border.

cn.name: Greater Tech Challenge 2025
cn.description: 面向 AI、清洁科技、生物科技和先进基础设施团队的旗舰中拉创新竞赛。
cn.detailSubtitle: 这是一项面向跨境增长团队的创业竞赛，帮助具备中国与拉美协同潜力的项目获得资金、曝光和关键连接。
cn.metaTitle: Greater Tech Challenge 2025 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 了解 Greater Tech Challenge 2025，这是一项面向深科技创业者的中拉旗舰竞赛。
cn.overviewHtml:
Greater Tech Challenge 2025 面向正在解决工业、气候与基础设施关键问题的创业团队，这些问题在拉美和中国都具有真实需求。

项目把奖金、曝光和高质量引荐结合在一起，帮助优秀团队把关注度转化为商业推进。
cn.eligibilityHtml:
• 拥有可演示产品、试点项目或成熟技术原型的团队。
  • 能够说明为什么中拉协同会带来增长杠杆的创业公司。
  • 聚焦 AI、清洁科技、生物科技、先进制造、物流或相关深科技领域的项目。
cn.supportHtml:
• 奖金池竞争资格与决赛展示机会。
  • 通过 LATAM China Tech 获得投资人和企业资源引荐。
  • 在正式提交前获得申请辅导、定位建议和叙事优化支持。
cn.processHtml:
在这里可重点呈现路演叙事、行业依据、伙伴匹配度和跨境增长逻辑，让评审团队先理解项目的核心优势。

LATAM China Tech 团队可以持续更新项目照片、决赛指导和该竞赛的专属说明。
cn.featureImageAlt: 创始人正在准备跨境竞赛路演。
